description: We are a multidisciplinary team of four engineering students: Mohammad Alqam and Amer Almasri (Computer Engineering), and Baraa Issa and Zain Issa (Modern Vehicle Engineering). Our skills include C++, Python, Java, problem-solving, software engineering, and 3D modeling using Blender and AutoCAD. We are passionate about technology, innovation, and using engineering to solve real-world challenges through creative teamwork.
